The '''Trindellan oak''' grew on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Trindello/Legends|Trindello]]. The gigantic [[Oak tree|oaks]] shared a [[Plant/Legends|root]] system and had a very hard [[Color/Legends|dark green]] [[Wood/Legends|wood]]. [[Kargul]] [[Worm/Legends|worms]] laired in Trindellan oak clusters, and several parties carried out [[logging]] operations to harvest the oaks' wood for use in construction throughout Trindello's [[Moddell sector/Legends|sector]].

==Biology and appearance==
The Trindellan oak was a type of gigantic [[oak tree]] that grew on [[Trindello/Legends|Trindello]], a small, [[Temperature/Legends|cool]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]]<ref name="Endor" /> located in the [[Trindello system/Legends|Trindello system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Trindellan oaks had a shared [[Plant/Legends|root]] system, and what appeared to be free-standing [[Tree/Legends|trees]] were in fact merely fast-growing shoots of it. The [[Wood/Legends|wood]] obtained from Trindellan oaks was [[Color/Legends|dark green]] and nearly as hard as [[Iron/Legends|iron]]. The oaks grew in clusters that covered their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], and [[kargul]], burrowing [[Worm/Legends|worms]] that could reach eighty [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length, laired at the center of the clusters.<ref name="Endor" />

==History==
The Moddell [[Sector/Legends|sector]] corporation [[Tripartite Lines]], as well as affluent businessbeings from the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Annaj/Legends|Annaj]] and [[Maya Kovel/Legends|Maya Kovel]], financed Trindellan oak [[logging]] operations run by [[Human/Legends|Human]] and [[Vashan]] cutters. Although [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] issued warnings that not enough information was available on the trees to ensure that they were not overharvested, the trade was lucrative enough for the logging parties to ignore those concerns. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]],<ref name="Endor" /> which lasted from [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] to [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]],<ref name="TEA" /> several parties of the Trindellan oak harvesters had come into conflict with kargul.<ref name="Endor" />

==Trindellan oaks in the galaxy==
The hardness of the Trindellan oak wood rendered it commonly used in construction throughout the Moddell sector. Large platforms made out of the trees were built atop [[Water/Legends|freshwater]] vents across the [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]]-covered planet [[Thonner/Legends|Thonner]], thus forming the world's first settlements in [[25 BBY/Legends|25 BBY]].<ref name="Endor" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Kargul.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Chris Trevas's illustration of a kargul in a Trindellan oak cluster]]
The Trindellan oak was first mentioned in the article "[[Endor and the Moddell Sector]]," which was published in the [[Star Wars Gamer 9|ninth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Gamer]]'' magazine<ref name="Endor" /> on [[February 22]], [[2002]].<ref name="GamerDate">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/other/rpg/news20020222.html|text=Starfighters Soar in Gamer #9}}</ref> [[Chris Trevas]] also depicted a cluster of Trindellan oaks in an illustration of a kargul meant for inclusion in<ref name="Trevas">{{WebCite|url=http://www.christrevas.com/starwars/rpg_ua4.html|text=Portfolio - Star Wars: Ultimate Adversaries|author=[[Chris Trevas]]|archivedate=20080915191135|nolive=1}}</ref> the [[2004]] [[Wizards of the Coast]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Ultimate Adversaries]]'', but the creature was ultimately not featured in the book.<ref name="UA">''[[Ultimate Adversaries]]''</ref> The illustration depicted an agitated kargul emerging from underground at a Trindellan oak logging site, although the trees' wood was tan-colored<ref name="Trevas" /> as opposed to dark green as established in "Endor and the Moddell Sector."<ref name="Endor" />
